x.author: Aaron Levie
x.role: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
x.summary: Box CEO Aaron Levie 指出，AI 智能体（Agent）正迎来爆发式增长，未来将以百倍于人类的规模处理专业任务。随着智能体工作负载的激增，企业必须在生产力提升与数据安全治理之间找到全新的平衡点，这将是 21 世纪最核心的技术挑战之一。
x.translation:
我们可能都需要更新对智能体工作负载的认知，结合智能体集群（Agent Swarms）、更强的计算机使用能力、新一代 API 与 MCP 标准，以及 Muse 或 Instinct 等新型硬件形态，再加上垂直领域企业智能体、后台工作流智能体等正在涌现的产品，未来已至。

我们将会在职业和个人生活中，将远超预期的任务交给智能体去处理。智能体在后台为我们搜集信息并执行工作的总量，将是此前单次 Prompt 交互所能想象的 100 倍。

未来，智能体将 24/7 全天候为你精准招聘人才，从客户业务的每一个信号中捕捉销售契机，处理每一份转录稿以获取产品洞察，审查每一行代码的安全性与 Bug，并对系统进行暴力测试，以及执行成百上千种其他任务。

我们目前对这些智能体的形态、部署方式、管理模式及预算规划的认知，可能还不到其最终样貌的 1%。但这种规模的变革已不可逆转，其程度在过去是难以想象的。

在一个智能体使用我们系统的频率是人类百倍的世界里，保护企业数据将成为 21 世纪最复杂的安全与治理挑战之一。

重要的是，在 AI 世界中，安全与生产力提升是密不可分的。如果你给予智能体过多不受限制的信息访问权限，将难以真正控制和保护数据；反之，如果你将一切完全封锁，就无法从 AI 中获得真正的生产力提升。

我们需要通过现代化安全与治理手段，以智能化方式保护企业系统、环境以及结构化与非结构化数据。

以 Box 为例，我们正在构建保护企业数据及智能体使用信息的新型智能方案。Box Shield 的最新更新提供了基于文档分类级别的细粒度控制，限制智能体可操作的内容范围。我们还在开发其他功能，以自动检测并预警（或拦截）智能体对数据的异常访问或使用行为。

这仅仅是个开始。整个行业正迎来海量创新——从 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 等实验室，到 Palo Alto Networks、Cisco、CrowdStrike、Okta 等安全平台，再到 Enclave、Method、Alterion、Runlayer 等初创公司，都在重新思考如何在 AI 智能体时代保护信息。前方是激动人心且狂野的时代。
x.recommendation: Levie 深刻揭示了从“人机交互”向“智能体协同”范式转移的必然性，特别是对安全治理（Security & Governance）的预判极具前瞻性。对于 AI 从业者而言，这篇观点不仅是产品路线图的参考，更是重新审视企业级 AI 落地边界的必读指南。

rawTweets.text:
We probably need to all update our sense of what’s coming in terms of agentic workloads with the combination of agent swarms, better computer use, the next wave of APIs and MCPs coming online, and new form factors like Muse or Instinct, vertical enterprise agents, background workflow agents, and other products that are emerging right now. 

We’re going to throw agents at vastly more tasks in our professional and personal lives than we had initially imagined. The kind of information that agents will go out and find for us and do work for us in the background is going to be 100X more volume than what we can imagine previously prompting in a single session. 

You’re going to have agents go out and surgically recruit talent for you 24/7, look for every signal in your customer’s business for when to pitch them, process every single transcript and conversation for product insights, review every line of code written for security issues and bugs, brute force test your systems for issues, and 100s of other tasks.

We’re probably 1% of the way into the shape of what all these agents look like, where they get deployed from, how they get managed, how we budget for them, and so on. But it’s inevitably going to happen at a scale that wouldn’t have been fathomable before.

Protecting enterprise data in a world where agents are using our systems 100X more than people ever did is going to be one of the more complex security and governance challenges of the 21st century. 

Importantly, security and productivity gains are inexorably linked in the world of AI. If you give an agent too much unfettered information access, it will be difficult to truly control and protect your data; and conversely, if you lock everything down completely, you won’t get any real productivity gains from AI.

We need all new ways to protect our systems, environments, and structured and unstructured dada in the enterprise in an intelligent way by modernizing our approach to security and governance.

At Box, as one example, we’re building new intelligent ways to protect enterprise data and agentic use of that information. A recent update in Box Shield is to provide granular controls on what content agents can and can’t work with based on document classification level. We’re also working on other features that can automatically detect and alert (or block) when data is being accessed or used in unusual or anomalous ways by agents.

And this is just the start. There’s a ton more innovation coming across the entire industry - from the labs like OpenAI or Anthropic; security platforms like Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Okta; or startups like Enclave, Method, Alterion, Runlayer, and many many others - to rethink how we protect information in the world of AI agents. Exciting and wild times ahead.

x.summary: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 领投了燃料支付平台 Piston 的 A 轮融资。Piston 通过绕过传统信用卡网络，利用自有支付轨道解决车队燃油欺诈问题，实现了支付量 8 倍增长及 98% 以上的客户留存率。
x.translation:
我长期以来一直痴迷于闭环支付，并一直在寻找一家试图解决实际问题的公司……很高兴最终投资了 Piston (piston.com) ⛽️。

仅美国在燃油上的支出就高达数千亿美元。大部分支出通过卡片（信用卡、燃油卡或内部卡）完成。然而，许多卡片甚至没有绑定特定司机，经常被盗、被侧录或滥用。车队所有者不得不承担欺诈损失，并花费大量时间核对账目。加油站为了接受这些卡片必须支付手续费，却与另一端的车队没有任何直接联系。许多公司试图优化这种基础设施，却没能从源头思考问题。

你无法仅通过制造一张更好的燃油卡来解决这个问题。卡片本身就是问题所在，因此 Piston 决定彻底抛弃它。它将支付转移到自己的轨道上，无需网络或任何中介。Piston 向加油站付款，然后向车队开具发票。每笔交易都绑定了特定的司机、时间、地点和燃油类型，很快它还将与车辆本身集成。

创始人亲身经历过这个问题。@vik_sekhon 经营着自己的卡车车队，他的车队因燃油欺诈损失了真金白银。@Shivam2291 曾招聘过数千名司机，两人联手打造了 Piston。衡量 Piston 对车队有效性的最佳信号是：当他们切换到 Piston 时，燃油支出会自动下降。我见过许多图表和客户评价直接证明了这一点。

客户的喜爱体现在数据上。支付量增长了 8 倍，商户网络增长了 40 倍，而留存率保持在 98% 以上。Piston 目前已覆盖全美 48 个州的 2,000 个加油站。车队目前无需支付任何费用，即可获得卡片系统无法提供的防欺诈功能。加油站则获得了与车队直接联系的渠道，有助于建立忠诚度并提供周边产品。

为了扩大覆盖范围，Piston 现在直接与美国大多数加油站的 POS 系统集成。这使他们能够一次性激活数百个加油站，确保供应，从而满足他们日益增长的需求。

很高兴能领投他们的 A 轮融资并加入董事会，与现有投资者 @sparkcapital 和 @pearvc 并肩作战。特别感谢 @arpans 去年将我介绍给这个团队！

I have been obsessed with closed payment loops for a LONG time, and have been looking to find a company trying to solve a real problem.. excited to finally back Piston (piston dot com) ⛽️

USA alone spends hundreds of billions in fuel. Most of that spend comes through cards (credit, fuel, or sometime house cards). However, a lot of these cards are not even tied to a particular driver. They often get stolen, skimmed, or misused. The fleet owner then has to eat the fraud and then spend a long time reconciling what exactly happened. The gas station has to pay interchange fees to accept the card, but has no relationship with the fleets on the other side. And a lot of companies have come and gone trying to optimize this infrastructure rather than thinking about it from the very beginning.

You really can't fix this issue by JUST building a better fuel card. The card is the problem, and so Piston decided to get rid of it. It moves the payment over its own rails without networks or any intermediaries. Piston pays the station and then invoices the fleet. Every transaction is tied to a specific driver with the time, location, and fuel type attached, and soon it'll be integrated with the vehicle itself.

The founders faced this problem themselves. @vik_sekhon runs his own fleet of trucks, and his fleet lost real money to fuel fraud. @Shivam2291 used to recruit thousands of drivers before the two of them got together to help build Piston. The best signal for how effective Piston is for fleets is the moment they switch over to Piston, they see their fuel spend automatically go down. blogs.title: How we contain Claude across products
blogs.summary: Anthropic 在本文中探讨了如何通过“限制爆炸半径”（Blast Radius）来安全部署 Claude 智能体。核心观点认为，随着模型能力增强，单纯依赖“人在回路”（Human-in-the-loop）的监督模式因用户疲劳（93%的批准率）而失效，必须转向“容器化防御”（Containment）。Anthropic 通过沙箱、虚拟机及出口流量控制等架构手段，针对 claude.ai、Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 三类产品构建了差异化的安全边界，旨在平衡高能力智能体的生产力提升与系统安全性风险。
blogs.translation: 一年前，我们绝不会允许 Claude 拥有可能导致内部服务瘫痪的权限，但现在这已成为常态。部署风险由“失败概率”和“潜在损害”组成，随着模型能力提升，我们必须通过控制环境来限制其“爆炸半径”。我们发现，依赖用户手动批准的监督模式存在严重的“批准疲劳”，因此转向了更底层的容器化防御，通过沙箱、虚拟机和出口控制来限制智能体的操作权限。针对不同的产品形态，我们构建了多层次的防御架构，以应对用户误用、模型越狱及智能体自主行为带来的安全挑战。
blogs.recommendation: 本文揭示了从“人工监督”转向“环境隔离”的安全工程演进路径，对于研发高权限 AI Agent 的团队具有极高的参考价值，特别是关于如何通过沙箱和出口控制来量化并限制 AI 的潜在破坏力。

blogs.title: An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
blogs.summary: Anthropic 近期针对 Claude Code 用户反馈的性能下降问题进行了深度复盘。调查发现，问题源于三个独立的技术变更：一是将默认推理强度从“高”降为“中”导致模型智力下降；二是会话清理逻辑的 Bug 导致模型出现重复性遗忘；三是过度的系统提示词优化反而损害了代码质量。目前所有问题已在 v2.1.116 版本修复。Anthropic 强调，此类问题并非模型本身退化，而是产品层面的配置与逻辑错误，公司已通过重置订阅用户限额等措施进行补偿，并承诺改进评估体系以更早识别此类偏差。
